# Portfolio project instructions

- Preserve the Node.js, Express, Pug and JSON-content architecture.
- Do not invent career dates, employers, project results, metrics or implementation details.
- Do not add proprietary source code, confidential architecture, customer information, credentials or real medical data.
- Keep public demonstrations synthetic and contact details verified.
- Maintain responsive layouts, keyboard accessibility, reduced-motion support and dark/light themes.
- Run `npm test` after route or template changes.
